jobs.occupation: Two 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD or the equivalent. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on

• Research potential within different aspects of leadership studies in a Nordic context and within life-long learning for working professionals.
• Demonstrable experience with executive education and external engagement based on direct participation in executive education activities, including development and teaching of high-quality offerings in the executive education area.
• Demonstrable interest in developing and co-creating new educational formats that address changing learning and competence needs of relevance for life-long learning, in part by further developing CBS Executive Education’s collaboration with external partners and the CBS Executive Education Foundation.
• Professional proficiency in both Danish and English (written and spoken).
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

The application must include:

• A summary of the candidate’s key abilities and qualifications.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review is allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, teaching incl executive education, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV
Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process has been completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information please contact: Head of Department MSC Dorte Salskov-Iversen tel.: +45 3815 3181, e-mail dsi.msc@cbs.dk.

For information on the recruitment process, please contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application: Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application deadline: 19 November 2026

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

jobs.occupation: BM-Gulvservice ApS is hiring a Floor Layer with Mechanical Skills
jobs.description:
BM-Gulvservice ApS is looking for a motivated Floor Layer to join our team working with the installation, renovation and finishing of wooden floors.

Your primary responsibility will be practical flooring work at customer sites. We are particularly interested in applicants with good mechanical understanding who can also help maintain our equipment, identify faults and carry out minor mechanical repairs when needed.

Job title: Floor Layer
DISCO-08 code: 712200

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Measure and prepare work areas and subfloors.

• 
Cut, fit and install wooden flooring.

• 
Sand and renovate existing wooden floors.

• 
Prepare surfaces and apply finishing treatments.

• 
Check the quality of completed work, including joints, levels and surface finish.

• 
Operate flooring machinery and carry out routine equipment checks and maintenance.

• 
Identify common mechanical faults and perform minor repairs or adjustments at customer sites, within your competence and according to manufacturer instructions.

• 
Report faults requiring specialist repair and keep tools and equipment in good working condition.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has a practical or technical background and an interest in quality flooring work.

• 
Works accurately with measurements, materials and tools.

• 
Has good mechanical understanding and practical skills in equipment maintenance and minor repairs.

• 
Can approach mechanical problems systematically and recognise when specialist assistance is required.

• 
Is reliable, takes responsibility and works well with colleagues.

• 
Can communicate in English and understand work and safety instructions.

Previous experience with wooden flooring is an advantage. Relevant technical training and practical skills gained in another field will also be considered.

Training in our flooring methods and familiarisation with our specific equipment will be provided according to your background.

WE OFFER

• 
A full-time position primarily focused on wooden flooring.

• 
Varied installation and renovation projects at customer sites.

• 
The opportunity to use and develop both flooring and mechanical skills.

• 
Cooperation with experienced colleagues.

• 
Salary according to qualifications and employment conditions consistent with Danish standards.

HOW TO APPLY

We welcome applications from candidates in Denmark and abroad.

Please send your CV, relevant certificates and a short application in English using the contact details provided in this advertisement.

Describe your practical background and any experience with flooring, tools, machinery maintenance or repairs.

Start date by agreement, subject to any required work authorisation.

BM-Gulvservice ApS

jobs.occupation: Manager for the Drug Product Development and Analysis Team
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where you can explore scientific challenges and have a significant impact? Are you passionate about developing life-saving vaccines, and enjoy close collaboration and leading a small development team?

We are expanding and looking for a new Manager to support our development projects!

**Join our team and let us make a difference together

**Our Process Development department in Hørsholm develops and optimizes vaccine production processes and supports our production sites. The Department handles diverse and evolving tasks and includes 32 members across 4 specialized teams.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. The team focuses on drug product process and formulation development, stability studies, and analyzing development samples for ongoing programs.

Apart from managing the team an important part of the role will be hands-on to review analytical results, maintain the analytical methods and drive the execution of the analytical tasks in the team.

“We look forward to welcoming you to a dedicated and engaged department, where we value good team spirit and an easy-going, humorous environment,” says Janus Falhof, Head of Process Development.

**Your Impact

**You must have a strong interest in consistently delivering high-quality analytical data and to support the department’s development studies. Given the function of the team, there will be close interaction with all the teams in the department.

Your tasks will include:

• Driving the daily operation of the team, setting the scientific direction, and ensuring the development of the team members

• Ensuring established analysis assays run smoothly and deliver high-quality data on time, while supporting the team in developing new assays to advance the department

• Communicating daily with the team and collaborating closely with Production, Quality Control, and R&D

**Are You Our Next Pioneer?

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

• M.S. in Biotechnology, Human Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, preferably with a PhD in protein chemistry or a related topic

• 3-5 years of relevant experience from the biotech industry or academia Previous experience with pharmaceutical analyses, e.g. chromatographic methods, particle methods and protein methods

• Previous experience with formulation development, statistical data analysis, and an understanding of protein chemistry

• Fluency in spoken and written English is required

**Who Are You?

**You are self-driven, responsible, and approach scientific challenges with curiosity and innovation. Success relies on strong teamwork, people skills, and the ability to engage in cross-functional dialogue. A proactive, calm, and positive attitude, combined with adaptability to new priorities, is beneficial. Good teamwork abilities are essential in a diverse, international department.

**Why join us?

**

• Be part of a team that directly contributes to global health by manufacturing and developing life-saving vaccines

• Your work here has a visible and significant impact, ensuring the safety and well-being of millions

• Join the fascinating field of vaccine production, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to protect public health

• Enjoy a vibrant staff club that offers a variety of diverse, fun, and exciting events

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

Are you passionate about software architecture and motivated by shaping the technology foundation behind innovative energy solutions? Do you enjoy defining architecture strategies, influencing technology direction, and solving complex technical challenges across embedded, cloud, and connectivity platforms?

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

**About The Job

**As System Architect, Software, you will play a key role in defining and driving the software architecture that supports DEIF's controllers, connectivity, and cloud solutions – and as part of this you will also spearhead our Cyber Security efforts.

You will help shape the future technological direction of DEIF by establishing architecture principles, defining reference architectures, and guiding development teams in creating secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

Working closely with software architects, hardware architects, product architects, development teams, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that technology decisions support both current product development and DEIF's long-term ambitions.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture behind innovative energy solutions used by customers worldwide and contribute to technologies that support a more sustainable future.

Read more about DEIF’s performance and strategic initiatives and goals here .

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Define and drive the software architecture strategy across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms

• Develop and maintain DEIF's software reference architecture

• Ensure architecture decisions support business objectives, scalability, security, and maintainability

• Collaborate with software, hardware, and product architects to create a unified technology roadmap

• Guide and support development teams on architecture and design decisions

• Guide and support the entire organization on Cyber Security (IEC62443, NIS2, CRA etc.)

• Evaluate technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns to support future product development

• Drive architectural consistency across products and platforms

• Contribute to the integration of emerging technologies such as AI, Machine Learning, advanced connectivity, and cloud-native solutions

• Promote best practices within software quality, cyber security, lifecycle management, and governance

• Participate in strategic development projects and help solve complex technical challenges

**Your profile

**You are an experienced Software Architect who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to influence and set direction across a large engineering organisation. You communicate complex technical concepts clearly, build alignment among stakeholders, and are comfortable challenging existing approaches when better solutions exist.

You possess the credibility, assertiveness, and collaborative mindset needed to drive architectural decisions across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms while ensuring long-term scalability, security, and business value.

**Furthermore, You

**

• Have 5-7 years experience with software architecture and modern software development

• Bring expertise in cloud technologies, cyber security, and scalable software design

• Have experience with embedded systems, connectivity solutions, and/or AI technologies

• Possess strong programming skills in technologies such as C++, C#, or Java

• Enjoy influencing technical direction and collaborating across disciplines

• Communicate fluently in English

**Why join DEIF?

**At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• A key architectural role with significant influence on DEIF's future technology direction

• The opportunity to shape software platforms and products used globally

• Close collaboration with highly skilled specialists across software, hardware, and product development

• Flexible work arrangements, including home office days

• A modern work environment with state-of-the-art facilities

• In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters

• Fitness activities, social events, and a strong focus on wellbeing

Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our career page today!

**Job Description

**Are you a self-starting transformation driver, strategic thinker and pragmatic deliverer, who turns a long-term vision and complex objectives into step-by-step reality and a clear path forward? Do you possess strong project management skills with the ability to translate a multi-year roadmap into smaller bricks and actionable wins, keeping momentum high as requirements evolve? Are you a gifted communicator who breaks down silos and unites cross-functional teams around a lean way of working? Do you possess the business acumen and analytical skills to spot risks and interdependencies across projects and complex organizations? **If so, join us as S&OP Project Manager!

****What The Job Is …

**We have embarked on a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation program through 2030 to support the long-term growth and industrialization of Satair and Airbus Material Services. We are redesigning the Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD) across various domains and organizations, for a lean operating model powered by a Fit-to-Standard modern ERP and harmonized processes.

One of the key cornerstones of this transformation is the deployment of an integrated end-to-end Sales and Operations Planning process across various businesses.

In your position as S&OP Project Manager you will be part of a cross-functional and cross-organizational project team. In addition to designing and implementing the TO BE S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD), you will act as the key point between our external consultancy partners, internal business stakeholders and the broader enterprise transformation program.

_Travel required: 15%

_**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**

• PMTD and Architecture Design and Implementation: Design the target Process, Method, Tools and Data covering customer demand, supply capacity and feedback loop mechanisms, including scenario-planning and escalation protocols across and between businesses. Partner with IT and Digital to define the future ERP requirements for S&OP, ensuring a seamless and integrated architecture between Processes and Tools.

• Project Management: Define project roadmap, translate long-term ambition into short-term milestones, maintain project governance, ensure progress towards deliverables, identify and proactively manage interdependencies and risks.

• Stakeholder Alignment Beyond Silos: Proactively identify and engage senior stakeholders across functions and organizations in a complex environment to drive alignment on future ways of working, overcome organizational friction and secure global process simplification and standardization.

• Consultant Management: Lead the relationship with external consultants, steering their deliverables to shape our target S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD). Validate consultant proposals and recommendations against business needs and context, ensuring designs are scalable and implementable across various business units.

• Strategic Escalations & Executive Briefings: Prepare executive-ready decks, high-impact decision dossiers, trade-off analysis, recommendations and progress updates for executive forums and the central Transformation steering.

• ERP Fit-to-Standard (F2S): Drive business readiness and stakeholder participation across multi-functional teams for F2S workshops to design the future ERP requirements. Safeguard S&OP scope requirements within the central ERP system, ensuring seamless alignment between S&OP process and the future ERP capabilities.

• Ad-Hoc Initiatives: Lead other potential initiatives or projects related to S&OP.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Core experience and background:

**

• Education: MSc/MA in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field

• Experience and Track record: 5-8+ years of experience in Project Management, Supply Chain, Management Consulting or equivalent. Proven track record in project management, S&OP deployment, leading cross-functional teams or enterprise process redesigns.

• Methodologies: Mastery of structured project management and business process mapping.

• Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Good command of French or German is a plus.

**Work Style And Soft Skills

**

• You are self-driven, proactive and autonomous

• You can translate complex long-term objectives into clear sequential steps. You have a strong focus on driving progress and delivering results, ensuring execution momentum even when requirements change.

• You can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution

• You are analytical, and enjoy understanding the intricacies of how things work

• You are excellent at stakeholder management and can navigate large organizations with ease

• You are a natural communicator and consensus builder, with the ability to understand and demystify complex concepts to obtain stakeholder buy-in

• You have the ability to influence senior leaders, negotiating trade-offs and overcoming organizational resistance.

• You have excellent analytical skills and business acumen, able to translate complex information into clear recommendations

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.3 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

_

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• Create engaging visual communication, including icons, visual concepts, posters, images, and other branded materials using Adobe tools.

• Develop content supporting marketing and communication activities across Digital & Lifecycle Services.

• Collaborate with global marketing teams to create and launch marketing materials such as sales presentations, fact sheets, product descriptions, and other communication assets.

• Contribute to our Service Partner Program, developing branded materials such as presentations, guides, fact sheets, visuals, and other supporting content.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for someone who combines creativity with a structured approach and enjoys turning ideas into communication that is easy to understand and visually engaging.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Bring

**

• Experience with graphic design, content creation, communication, or marketing and familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, video editing skillset, or similar.

• A structured, hands-on approach and the ability to coordinate tasks and projects involving different stakeholders

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization with international and cross-functional environment.

• Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Relevant education in communication, marketing, business, design, or a related field.

Experience with B2B marketing, business consultancy, campaigns, agency work, or service-related businesses would be an advantage, but it is not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to create communication that makes an impact.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you’ll gain broad experience across visual communication, content creation, global marketing collaboration, and events, while working with colleagues and stakeholders across an international organization.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about combining creativity, communication, and collaboration to help make complex solutions clear and engaging, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. If this opportunity interests you and you believe your experience and perspective could add value to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

jobs.occupation: Lead Robotics/Drone Software & Computer Vision Engineer for TRDP ApS
jobs.description:
TRDP is a Danish defence-tech startup developing autonomous interceptor drone systems.

We are a small, hands-on team of 10 engineers and specialists working across robotics, software, electronics, mechanical engineering, drone building and flight testing.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines hands-on software development, computer vision, AI and systems architecture with the ability to guide a small engineering team.

Our software team currently consists of three robotics engineers with experience in mobile robotics, drones and visual odometry.

Your responsibilities

• 
Take an active role in software development, integration and testing.

• 
Contribute to computer vision, AI-based perception, object detection, tracking and sensor fusion.

• 
Design and maintain the overall software architecture.

• 
Coordinate and prioritise development tasks within the software team.

• 
Integrate software, sensors, electronics and control systems.

• 
Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

• 
Work closely with our electronics, mechanical engineering and flight-testing teams.

Your background

• 
Degree in robotics, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

• 
Strong practical experience with robotics software and complex system integration.

• 
Solid knowledge of computer vision, AI and sensor fusion.

• 
Experience with software architecture and embedded systems.

• 
Ability to guide other engineers while contributing directly to development.

• 
Experience with C++, Python, ROS 2, PX4/ArduPilot or similar technologies is an advantage.

Who you are

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong understanding of complete robotic systems.

You enjoy writing code, solving complex technical challenges and turning ideas into working prototypes. You can guide specialists, make architectural decisions and ensure that individual technologies work together.

Our culture and mindset

At TRDP, we believe in no bullshit, taking responsibility and getting things done. We value practical skills, direct communication, technical curiosity and people who turn ideas into working solutions.

We also believe that the things we hold dear are worth fighting for. That conviction drives our work in defence technology. We are looking for people who share that mindset and want their engineering skills to make a real difference.

Working language: English.

Contact: talents@trdp.dk
Website: www.trdp.dk

**Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for an Application/IT Supporter who will be responsible for the technical deployment, support and ongoing operation of UNEEG's software solutions. You will help onboard new hospital customers, with a primary focus on the US market, while ensuring excellent service and operational continuity for our existing customers.

You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. Working closely with the Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance, you will be the technical bridge between hospital IT teams and colleagues across Commercial, Clinical Operations and Technology. The role includes both remote and on-site support, and travel can be expected.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Plan, install, configure and test data transfer infrastructure solutions in hospitals

• Provide remote and on-site support for installations, upgrades, operation and troubleshooting

• Train hospital IT staff and system administrators to maintain deployed solutions effectively

• Monitor and maintain hospital servers, cloud clients and Microsoft Azure environments

• Troubleshoot networking, data communication, application and system performance issues

• Configure and manage virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes environments, and deploy patches and updates

• Document support cases and technical issues in Jira and collaborate with software developers on resolution and product improvements

• Maintain deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides and other technical documentation in line with healthcare IT and data security requirements

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are service-minded, outgoing and persistent, and enjoy working directly with customers

• Take ownership, follow up rigorously and solve problems before they arise

• Can manage several tasks at the same time while staying structured and attentive to detail

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy collaborating across commercial, clinical and software development teams

• Are flexible when customer needs occasionally require support across time zones or outside normal working hours

**Your background:

**

• An education as an IT Support Technician or Data Technician, ideally focused on infrastructure, or a relevant degree in software development, infrastructure or a related field

• Experience or strong interest in customer-facing technical service or IT support; newly educated candidates with the right mindset are also encouraged to apply

• Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, virtualization and container-based environments, including Kubernetes

• Knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server, and scripting

• Ability to troubleshoot networking, application and system performance issues

• Experience with defect tracking and monitoring tools, such as Jira, Prometheus, Grafana or Azure Monitor

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Healthcare IT, hospital environments or deployment in public-sector organizations

• Healthcare data standards, hospital IT security protocols or clinical trial workflows

• ITIL or similar service management methodologies

• Data protection and privacy requirements, including GDPR and HIPAA

• Supporting international customers in Europe or the US

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Kubernetes Administrator

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.
